description: System saturation analysis based on real load testing up to 5,000 concurrent
findings: No user-facing endpoint saturated within tested range (0–5,000 concurrent)
Health endpoint (proxy) is first to show latency degradation — expected, not user-facing
DB pool is the only confirmed saturation point (20 max connections, hits limit at ~10 concurrent queries)
Queue system handles all enqueued jobs with 0 backlog
Redis memory: minimal usage (all queues at 0 depth)
Event loop: no saturation detected (services stable at all tested levels)
